messages:
maria: Heads-up — while testing KMS key rotation I noticed a permissions hole. After the RBAC refactor last week, users in the `platform-admin` role can still access the billing/usage analytics UI even though we intended to remove that ability.
kevin: ack. do you have repro steps?
maria: yes. steps: 1) rotate key via infra console 2) user with platform-admin logs into console 3) navigate to /admin/usage -> page loads with cost graphs.
maria: quick log snippet from the session: 
```
INFO 2025-11-02 AuthCheck user=alice role=platform-admin action=GET /admin/usage result=ALLOWED policy_evaluator=v2-refactor
```
lia: that looks like the policy identifier still maps platform-admin -> admin_view in the new policy mapping table. probably we missed removing the usage scope mapping.
own: if it's a mapping bug, it's high priority — exposed cost data is sensitive for PII+customer usage. tagging @security for severity.
security-bot: incident-sev:medium — flagged for vuln-triage. Suggested next steps: block access via short-term gate, add audit log entry, and create a fix PR.
kevin: short-term mitigation: we can add a feature-flagged middleware that denies /admin/usage unless the user has `billing.read` permission. I'll push a hotfix branch and deploy to staging.
maria: note: this only surfaces when KMS rotation is performed? i saw it while rotating because some auth checks call the legacy policy lookup path. others might hit it too.
lia: good catch. sounds like two issues: 1) policy refactor left legacy alias mapping for platform-admin 2) rotation path is invoking legacy policy service. both need fixes.
own: I'll open a triage ticket with repro and attach the audit logs. can someone run a quick query to see how many users/roles have that alias?
kevin: running a query now against policy-db: `SELECT role, alias FROM role_aliases WHERE alias = 'platform-admin'` -> returns 3 entries (platform-admin -> admin_view, platform-admin -> infra_ops, platform-admin -> legacy_billing).
maria: yikes — legacy_billing should've been removed. that explains it.
lia: plan: (1) hotfix middleware to block billing UI for non-billing roles (2) PR to clean up role_aliases and add migrations (3) update rotation path to call new policy-evaluator only (4) add an audit alert rule for unexpected usage UI access after role changes.
kevin: deployed hotfix to staging, requests to /admin/usage now 403 for platform-admin. pushing to prod after CI.
security-bot: reminder: we need an audit log event for any admin UI access that includes effective_permissions and policy_version. add to the spec for the next sprint.
maria: I'll create the vuln-triage doc and add severity/impact: "exposure of aggregated usage data (cost) to non-billing roles". marking PII risk as low but business sensitivity high.
own: creating the ticket: SEC-2291. assigning to lia (policy cleanup) and kevin (hotfix + rotation path).
lia: will include migration script and add unit tests to ensure alias removals block access. also adding an integration test where KMS rotation triggers the new evaluator.
kevin: prod rollout scheduled in 15m, will monitor audit stream for unexpected /admin/usage ALLOWED events.
maria: thanks everyone. once prod patch is live, I'll run a scan for any other endpoints using legacy evaluator.
audit-bot: audit-log: created event id=aud_20251102_01 actors=[maria,kevin] action=policy-change tags=[kms,rbac,rotation]
security-bot: follow-up: if we find more legacy-evaluator calls, escalate to infra-runbook and consider temporary network ACL to block legacy service until migration is complete. :warning:
kevin: noted. will post the deploy link and postmortem stub after monitoring period.
